narrative.overview:
Spensa's shopping surface is an airport departures board with a boarding pass pinned under it. Lists are strict columns, figures are tabular, categories are banded like gate groups, and a four-cell trip pass always says where the trip stands. Panels are flat, edges are hairlines, and the checkbox is a square with a yellow fill and an ink check.

Built for one-handed supermarket use: high contrast in every theme (light pass paper, dark ink and slate, AMOLED black), 44px targets, two densities. One softened alert yellow carries every attention meaning; red appears only for shortfall and error.
keyCharacteristics: Flat tonal panels with 1px rules; only the floating trip pass and dock button carry a shadow.
Caps tracked Barlow Semi Condensed for structure; Schibsted Grotesk for names and numbers.
Figures right-aligned in a fixed column with unit left-aligned beside.
Yellow is a fill on light, and text too on dark and AMOLED.

rules.name: The One Alert Rule
rules.body: Yellow means attention or active and nothing else. Never a second accent hue; red is reserved for shortfall and error.

rules.name: The Fill-Only On Paper Rule
rules.body: On the light theme yellow is a fill behind Ink, never a text or outline colour.

rules.name: The Ink On Yellow Rule
rules.body: Any yellow surface carries Ink text, in every theme.

rules.name: The Caps Are Structure Rule
rules.body: Tracked caps Barlow marks structure; names and amounts are never set in caps.

rules.name: The Figure Column Rule
rules.body: Numbers that line up are tabular and right-aligned in their own column; the unit sits left-aligned in the next.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Rows, bands, panels and cards carry no shadow. Only an element that floats above scrolling content may.

dos: Do align every figure to the shared board grid and use tabular numerals only in figure columns.
Do put yellow behind Ink text, and use --sp-accent where yellow-on-dark must become Ink-on-light.
Do keep rows at least 44px (compact) and size ticks and amounts from the density variables, never hard-coded.
Do use hairline rules and panel-versus-ground contrast for separation.
Do make state legible without colour alone: the held row carries a text note, the partner cell carries a name, the offline badge carries a word.
donts: Don't use soft white cards with rounded checkboxes or a green success colour; the world rejects the category default.
Don't add a second accent hue; red is only for shortfall and error.
Don't put yellow text or outlines on the light theme.
Don't add shadows to rows, bands or panels; only floating dock elements have one.
Don't set names or amounts in caps, or labels in the grotesk.
Don't use dot markers or glyph icons for status; markers are small hard squares and words.
